name: qfd_sys_face_mu_dhuser

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every used pin (qfd_sys_face_mu_dhuser PINREG 1): dh_run[42:36] lands in the pin flop dh_q7 with the anchor compensated (fc = tc = 1 on the anchor edge), so op starts stay cycle-identical to PINREG 0 (lockstep tb_dhuser_pinreg.sv, Verilator 5.050: MUT0 PASS, MUT4/5/6/7 FAIL); every output is a flop (op_v/op_user/op_stage/op_first/op_cnt/op_ff/op_fcode, mu_fault = mu_q) or constant 0 (dh_user/res_user); dh_run[43],[35:0] unused. A synthesis wrapper would add 2 unpriced edges.

structural_change: NEW leaf (MU-LEAF-KIT 10-19, MU-QW-B1 4b): the Qwen ROM 4-user op-start observer leaf qfd_sys_face_mu_dhuser NU 4 OPSEG 1 PINREG 1 hardened on its own: one ot_rom_4096x72_m8 (v2 aligned, F16 image rom/qfd_tt_ctlm_opseg.viamap.hex, content-independent macro; ROM instance parameters dropped under SYNTHESIS) 20 um from the E edge (its E face carries PG rects: macro_edge rule) with its W pin edge toward a W std-cell band (~200 flops: fc/tc 44, prefetch entry ~55, outputs 31, header ~56), all pins on the W face, ck mid-face beside the register band. PINREG 1 (opt-in, default 0 unchanged): pin flop on dh_run[42:36], compensated anchor, op starts cycle-identical.
slot_change_request: none: new observer leaf, no die slot yet; the compute-die integration (MU.TOK.QW B3) places it beside the qfd_tt_ctlm_dv cluster's dh_q register (it observes seq_dh only).

job.purpose: Qwen ROM 4-user op-start leaf (MU-QW-B1 B1 option 2) as its own hard leaf: ROM + frame counter; lockstep PINREG 1 vs PINREG 0 on the F16 image, 2 frames (8.09M edges, 8,113 starts), +DRIFT fault equivalence, 4 mutants FAIL.
